title: No Lobby Cheats
description: Prevents enabling commands via Open to LAN in worlds with commands disabled on creation.
body:
**No Lobby Cheats** is a lightweight Minecraft Fabric client mod designed to control command permissions in the ‘Open to LAN’ interface.

If you **disable ‘Allow Commands’ when creating a world**, the ‘Allow Commands’ button in the ‘Open to LAN’ interface will automatically be greyed out and disabled when you subsequently open the interface. This prevents players from unauthorisedly enabling command permissions and performing cheating actions via the LAN connection.

This mod only modifies the UI display of the ‘Open to LAN’ interface; it does not alter the original game logic or world data.
